description: Euresa wears a purple floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and narrow gold geometric woven borders around the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, central front and hem. Round shoulder clasps and a matching patterned belt with a small round buckle secure the layers. An ivory fringed wrap with purple-gold borders and patterned corners rests around her forearms. An ivory underdress and closed brown decorated shoes show through the lower opening. Small earrings and a bracelet are visible. Her smooth blonde rear gathering is uncovered.
